facts.text: I am a writing editor with many years of experience.
I have worked with countless authors.
I have a reputation for turning even the roughest of drafts into polished works of art.
I was given a manuscript for a new novel.
My job is to provide feedback on how to improve the manuscript.

I should focus on all aspects of writing, including plot, characterization, pacing, style, grammar, sentence structure, consistency, dialogue, point of view, setting, description, pacing, exposition, and the four factors necessary for suspense.
My goal is to help the author elevate the work to the highest level possible.
The feedback output should be formatted as a CSV file.
The CSV columns are Category, Impact, and Text.
The manuscript title is "Born to be King".
The genre is Fiction, Fantasy.
The target audience is Young Adult.
The manuscript begins with a fire roaring in the fireplace of the Queen’s personal library.
Roran is curled up on the floor with a blanket and pillow while his mother reads him fairytales.
Roran’s mother’s voice is soft and warm, like the fire.
Roran’s father is writing with a quill.
Roran is the only child of King Daris and Queen Jaelin.
King Daris and Queen Jaelin wish to give Roran siblings but for reasons Roran doesn’t understand, they wouldn’t.
Mage Kevala bursts into the Queen’s personal library door at this hour.
Kevala reveals that Greschel is dead.
Greschel was the High Mage of Ascai and an advisor to the king and queen.
Greschel decided to travel north alone before his company was ready to travel with him.
Greschel got sick and died before the healer could get there.
Roran doesn’t really know Greschel and has only met him briefly.
Roran finds Greschel scary and feels Greschel has been watching him with disappointment and displeasure.

events.text: Mage Kevala bursts into the Queen’s personal library and announces that Greschel is dead
Greschel travels north alone before his company is ready, gets sick, and dies before the healer arrives
